name: Vampire Lips
source: Vampire Lips is a short visual novel where you play John, who responds to a mysterious job offer. He meets Claudia on this occasion, who will give him a very detailed description of the job.​
translation: 《Vampire Lips》是一部短篇视觉小说。你将扮演约翰，应聘一份神秘的工作，并因此遇见克劳迪娅。她会向你详细说明这份工作的内容。
